Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Sections start with `.p2align 2`; GNU as gives SH code that alignment and pads
the end of the section to it.

=== a literal pool pointing into another section
        .text
        .p2align 2
        mov.l   lit, r0
        mov.l   @r0, r1
        rts
        nop
        .p2align 2
lit:    .long   msg
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .space  0x100
msg:    .long   1

=== data across sections
        .text
        .p2align 2
entry:
        rts
        nop
        .data
        .p2align 2
        .long   entry
        .long   entry - .
        .long   entry@PLT
        .long   entry@PCREL
